title: Zero-Plane Rigidity for Einstein Four-Manifolds
summary: We prove that a closed Einstein four-manifold with positive Einstein constant, nonnegative sectional curvature, and a zero-curvature plane has universal Riemannian cover isometric to a product of two round two-spheres. Under the normalization $`\mathop{\mathrm{Ric}}\nolimits =3g`$, both spheres have radius $`1/\sqrt3`$. The proof extends coupled estimates for the two Weyl curvature blocks to the boundary of the sectional-curvature cone and determines their equality case.
family_title: Nonnegative-curvature Einstein classification and an L 2 topological gap
